name: Tewksbury
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Tewksbury, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Tewksbury, MA: the Town Common tree lighting, Santa photos, a Santa Social with wagon rides at Krochmal Farms, and nearby trains.
lede: Tewksbury celebrates Christmas with a Friday night tree lighting on the Town Common and a farm Santa Social where a horse drawn wagon carries families to the North Pole.
celebrates: Tewksbury's season centers on the Annual Holiday Celebration and Tree Lighting on the Town Common at 1009 Main Street, hosted by the Town of Tewksbury on a Friday evening in early December. The town's flyer lists hot cocoa, an ice sculpture, marshmallows, balloons and pictures with Santa at Tewksbury Congregational Church. On Jennies Way, Krochmal Farms, run by the same family since 1942, turns its fields into a Santa Social with horse drawn wagon rides, bonfires, s'mores, farm animals and Christmas lights set to music.
lastyear: In 2025 the Town of Tewksbury held its 12th Annual Holiday Celebration and Tree Lighting on Friday, December 5, from 5 to 7 pm on the Town Common at 1009 Main Street. The town shared the plans on its own website and social media, and local news sites, including the Tewksbury Carnation and Patch, posted the details in the days before the lighting so families could plan their evening.
facts: Tewksbury was first settled in 1637 and was incorporated on December 17, 1734, when it split off from Billerica. There is no evidence that it was named after Tewkesbury in England. The most likely reason for the name is King George II of Great Britain, who held the title Baron of Tewkesbury from 1706 to 1714. Krochmal Farms has been in the same family since John Krochmal bought it in 1942.
trains: Tewksbury has no commuter rail station inside town, but the LRTA 12 bus connects it to both Lowell and Wilmington stations on the MBTA Commuter Rail Lowell Line, and from either stop a holiday trip into Boston is an easy train ride. For a Christmas train through the lights, Edaville in Carver runs its Holiday Express during a festival season with Santa, ice skating and carriage rides. Older kids who love transit history can join a Boston Street Railway Association talk.

kidfact: Tewksbury may be named for a king. King George II of Great Britain once held the title Baron of Tewkesbury.
faq: When is the Tewksbury tree lighting?

The Town of Tewksbury holds its Annual Holiday Celebration and Tree Lighting on the Town Common at 1009 Main Street on a Friday evening in early December. In 2025 it was the 12th year, held on Friday, December 5, from 5 to 7 pm. Watch the town website for the new date each fall.
Where can kids see Santa in Tewksbury?

At the town tree lighting, the flyer lists pictures with Santa at Tewksbury Congregational Church. Krochmal Farms on Jennies Way also runs a ticketed Santa Social on select December dates, with a horse drawn wagon ride to the farm's North Pole, hot cocoa and time to chat with Santa.
How does the Krochmal Farms Santa Social work?

The farm sells individual tickets and a package for up to 10 people that adds a s'mores kit, online only through its booking calendar. Children under 24 months are not counted. The event runs rain or snow, and the farm offers a reschedule or refund if weather forces a closure.
Is there a train station in Tewksbury?

No. The nearest MBTA Commuter Rail stops are Lowell and Wilmington on the Lowell Line, and the LRTA 12 bus connects Tewksbury to both. From either station, trains run into Boston, which makes a holiday day trip into the city easy without driving downtown.
